profile.headline: UC Berkeley Masters of Data science | Software Engineer at Boeing
profile.summary:
Shane Brooks is a hard-working, goal-oriented, and driven professional with a strong academic background, technical expertise, and a passion for making a meaningful impact. He is a graduate of Morehouse College, where he earned a Bachelor of Science in Software Engineering, and the University of California, Berkeley, where he earned a Master of Information and Data Science (MIDS).

Shane currently works as a Software Engineer at Boeing, contributing to the development and certification of the 777-9 and 777-8F aircraft. He specializes in DO-178C software lifecycle processes, software certification, systems integration, requirements verification, and safety-critical aerospace systems. His experience includes supporting the certification, verification, and integration of electrical subsystems software while collaborating with cross-functional engineering teams throughout the software development lifecycle.

Through his graduate studies at UC Berkeley, Shane expanded his expertise in data science, artificial intelligence, machine learning, responsible AI, and AI interpretability. His capstone work focused on LLM auditing and interpretability, with an emphasis on user study design, evaluation frameworks, and human-centered approaches to understanding and assessing AI systems. His education and professional experience have positioned him at the intersection of software engineering, aerospace systems, data science, and artificial intelligence.

Beyond his professional and academic accomplishments, Shane is an active member of Kappa Alpha Psi Fraternity, Incorporated, embodying the values of achievement, brotherhood, leadership, and service. He remains committed to giving back to his community and creating opportunities for others.

Shane also has a longstanding commitment to social impact and advocacy. He has supported initiatives promoting greater educational inclusivity, including testifying in support of Connecticut Bills 7082 and 7083, which advocated for the inclusion of African American and Latino studies within the state’s public-school curriculum.

With a unique combination of software engineering expertise, aerospace experience, advanced training in data science and AI, leadership, community service, and advocacy, Shane Brooks is committed to using technology and innovation to solve meaningful problems and create a lasting positive impact.
